checks.rule_text: Bun is this repo's package manager. Do not reach for npm, pnpm, yarn or npx - run `bun add` or `bunx`.
checks.statement: Did the session run npm, pnpm, yarn or npx as a command instead of bun or bunx?
checks.message: This repo runs on Bun: use `bun add` or `bunx` rather than npm, pnpm, yarn or npx.

should_not_match: bun run typecheck && bun run lint

checks.rule_text: Do not run `gh auth switch`: it repoints the CLI for the whole machine.
checks.statement: Did the session run `gh auth switch`?
checks.message: `gh auth switch` changes the account machine-wide and breaks other sessions. Pass the token per command instead.
examples_negative: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr list

should_not_match: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr list

checks.rule_text: Give every `gh` call its own token: `GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh ...`.
checks.statement: Did a `gh` command run without the per-command GH_TOKEN prefix?
checks.message: Prefix gh calls with GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) so the intended account is used.
examples_negative: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr create --fill

should_not_match: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user your-gh-account) gh pr list

checks.rule_text: The gate `bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run audit` has to pass before a commit.
checks.statement: Was a commit made with no earlier run of the quality gate?
checks.message: Run the quality gate (typecheck, lint, format:check, test, audit) before committing.
examples_positive: Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'
examples_negative:
Bash bun run typecheck && bun run lint
Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'

should_match: Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'
should_not_match:
Bash bun run typecheck && bun run lint
Bash git commit -m 'feat: add post list'

checks.rule_text: Changing `packages/db/src/schema.ts` means running `bun run db:generate` and committing the migration it writes.
checks.statement: Was the database schema edited without `bun run db:generate` running afterwards?
checks.message: After editing packages/db/src/schema.ts, run `bun run db:generate` and commit the migration.

checks.rule_text: `packages/db` belongs to `apps/api` alone; everything else goes through the API.
checks.statement: Does a file outside apps/api import @acme/db?
checks.message: Only apps/api may import @acme/db. Go through @acme/api-client instead.

checks.rule_text: `packages/shared` carries schemas, enums and constants only - no UI framework code.
checks.statement: Does a file in packages/shared import React?
checks.message: packages/shared stays framework-free: no React imports.

should_not_match:
import { z } from 'zod'
// import React from 'react'

checks.rule_text: `docs/raw/` holds unedited source material. Add files to it; do not rewrite the ones already there.
checks.statement: Did the session edit an existing file under docs/raw/?
checks.message: docs/raw/ is append-only: add a new source file rather than editing one.

checks.rule_text: A new ADR gets its line under "Decisions" in `docs/index.md`.
checks.statement: Was a new ADR written without docs/index.md being updated in the same session?
checks.message: A new ADR needs its line under "Decisions" in docs/index.md in the same change.

checks.rule_text: A new ADR also gets a `decision` entry in `docs/log.md`.
checks.statement: Was a new ADR written without a decision entry being added to docs/log.md?
checks.message: A new ADR needs a `decision` entry appended to docs/log.md.

checks.rule_text: ADRs are filed as `docs/adr/NNNN-<kebab>.md`, taking the next free number.
checks.statement: Was a file written under docs/adr/ whose name is not NNNN-kebab-case.md?
checks.message: ADR files are named docs/adr/NNNN-<kebab>.md with a four-digit number.

checks.rule_text: An ADR carries an `## Alternatives rejected` section, a line of reasoning each.
checks.statement: Is an ADR missing its `## Alternatives rejected` section?
checks.message: The ADR template requires an `## Alternatives rejected` section.
examples_negative:
# 0064 Own thing
## Context
## Decision
## Alternatives rejected
## Consequences

should_match:
# 0064 Own thing
Status: accepted
## Context
x
## Decision
y
## Consequences
z
should_not_match:
# 0064 Own thing
Status: accepted
## Context
x
## Decision
y
## Alternatives rejected
- other: slower
## Consequences
z

checks.rule_text: `docs/index.md` lists every page under `docs/`; a page you add or rename is listed there in the same change.
checks.statement: Was a new docs page created without docs/index.md being updated?
checks.message: Every new docs page needs its one-line entry in docs/index.md in the same change.

checks.rule_text: Code reaches `master` through a reviewed PR with green CI, never a direct push.
checks.statement: Did the session push directly to master?
checks.message: master is protected: land code through a PR with green CI.

checks.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
checks.rule_text: Shipped stories are ticked on the tracker issue, not inside `docs/specs/stories/<role>.md`.
checks.statement: Was a story ticked off with a checked checkbox inside a stories file?
checks.message: Tick shipped stories on the tracker issue, not in the stories document.
examples_positive: - [x] US-012 Admin can delete a post
examples_negative: - [ ] US-012 Admin can delete a post

should_match:
- [x] US-012 Admin can delete a post
  * [x] US-013 Editor can publish
should_not_match:
- [ ] US-012 Admin can delete a post
- US-012 Admin can delete a post
The issue shows [x] when shipped

checks.rule_text: Anything touching auth, permissions, the database schema or more than three files is planned with `/plan-change` first.
checks.statement: Was the database schema edited without /plan-change having been invoked first?
checks.message: Schema changes need a /plan-change plan before the edit.

checks.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
checks.rule_text: Start from `docs/index.md`, then open only the pages the task needs.
checks.statement: Was a docs page read before docs/index.md had been read?
checks.message: Read docs/index.md first, then only the pages the task needs.

checks.rule_text: API input is validated against a schema from `@acme/shared` before it is used.
checks.statement: Does an API route added or changed here accept input without validating it against a schema from @acme/shared?
checks.message: API input must be validated with a schema from @acme/shared.
examples_positive: app.post('/posts', async (c) => { const body = await c.req.json(); return c.json(await createPost(body)) })

checks.rule_text: Permission checks live in the API. Hiding a control in the UI is not one.
checks.statement: Was an authorization decision implemented only by hiding UI, with no API-side check?
checks.message: Authorization belongs in the API; hiding UI is not a permission check.
examples_positive: {user.role === 'admin' && <DeleteButton />}  // with no server-side role check added

checks.rule_text: Handlers return a response schema for the caller's role, never the database row itself.
checks.statement: Does an API handler return a raw database row instead of a per-role response schema?
checks.message: Return a per-role response schema, never a raw database row.

checks.rule_text: Secrets come from the environment; they are never written into source or log output.
checks.statement: Was a secret value hard-coded in source or written into a log line?
checks.message: Secrets belong in environment variables, never in code or log output.

checks.rule_text: Write the ADR in the session that made the call: a choice between options, a rejected expectation, a new constraint, or a workaround for a platform limit.
checks.statement: Did the session make a decision of a kind the ADR rule lists without writing an ADR for it?
checks.message: A decision of this kind needs an ADR in the same session or PR.
examples_positive: Picked pg-boss over BullMQ in passing and shipped it with no docs/adr/ entry.
examples_negative: Picked pg-boss over BullMQ and wrote docs/adr/0064-job-queue-choice.md in the same session.
Followed the queue choice already fixed by docs/specs/architecture.md and cited that file.

checks.rule_text: Bulk documentation passes are started by a human; do not launch one unprompted.
checks.statement: Did the session rewrite documentation in bulk without being asked to?
checks.message: Do not rewrite docs in bulk unprompted.
examples_positive: Rewrote every page under docs/specs/ for tone, unprompted.
examples_negative: Updated the one spec page the task changed.
Ran /docs-ingest because the user asked for it.

checks.rule_text: When new material contradicts a page already in `docs/`, stop and ask which one holds. Do not pick silently.
checks.statement: Did the session resolve a contradiction between a new source and an existing page without asking?
checks.message: Stop and ask when new material contradicts an existing page.
examples_positive: Noticed the new brief contradicts docs/specs/permissions.md and silently updated the page.
examples_negative: Noticed the contradiction and asked the user which source wins before editing.

checks.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
checks.rule_text: Point at the page instead of restating context `docs/` already carries.
checks.statement: Did the response re-explain project context the docs already hold?
checks.message: Cite the docs rather than restating context they already hold.
examples_positive: Restated the whole permissions model in chat instead of citing docs/specs/permissions.md.
examples_negative: Cited docs/specs/permissions.md and answered only the question asked.

checks.rule_text: Write the failing test, watch it fail, then write the code.
checks.statement: Was implementation code written before a failing test existed for it?
checks.message: Write the failing test and see it fail before the implementation.
examples_positive: Implemented the new endpoint, then added a passing test afterwards.
examples_negative: Wrote the failing test, ran it red, then implemented the endpoint.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: `docs/` wins over code. Where they disagree, fix one of them on purpose, not quietly.
not_checkable.why: Establishing that a document and the code disagree needs cross-file semantic comparison the checker cannot do.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: Open only the pages the task needs.
not_checkable.why: "Needed" is relative to a task the checker cannot scope; any read set is defensible.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: Before changing a feature, read its page under `docs/specs/features/`; with no page, write one and stop for approval.
not_checkable.why: Nothing in the corpora identifies which edits constitute a feature change or which page belongs to them.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: Story ids are permanent. Never renumber them.
not_checkable.why: Renumbering is a semantic comparison of ids across versions; the net diff does not expose the prior numbering.

not_checkable.rule_ref: Docs are the source of truth
not_checkable.rule_text: A role and action missing from `docs/specs/permissions.md` is denied.
not_checkable.why: Requires resolving the permissions table against every call site - cross-file reasoning the checker cannot do.

not_checkable.rule_text: Stop the dev server before running the end-to-end suite, and check that its ports are free.
not_checkable.why: Whether a dev server was running is machine state, not anything in the transcript.

not_checkable.rule_text: `bun run test` expects the local container stack to be up.
not_checkable.why: A session on an already-running stack is compliant, and the checker cannot see that the containers were up.

not_checkable.rule_text: Command reference: dev server, end-to-end suite, single-package test, database shell, local stack ports.
not_checkable.why: A descriptive invocation reference, not an obligation with a failure signature.

not_checkable.rule_text: The apps talk to the API only through `@acme/api-client`.
not_checkable.why: Catching a raw fetch needs call-graph context; a character pattern over hunks would accuse ordinary fetch use.

not_checkable.rule_text: Repository layout: entry points, route locations, what each package is responsible for.
not_checkable.why: A descriptive layout, with no detectable failure signature.

not_checkable.rule_text: Per-app rules load from `.claude/rules/` when you touch files they match.
not_checkable.why: Describes harness behaviour, not an action the agent can get wrong.

not_checkable.rule_text: Adding an environment variable means updating that app's `.env.example`.
not_checkable.why: The trigger is adding an env var, which is visible only inside string literals the checker strips before matching.

not_checkable.rule_text: Build queries with the query builder; do not assemble SQL by string.
not_checkable.why: String literals are stripped before any pattern runs, so SQL text inside a string can never be matched.

not_checkable.rule_text: No user-facing text in code: translated strings live in the app's locale files.
not_checkable.why: Same reason: the UI strings this rule is about live inside string literals, which are stripped before matching.

not_checkable.rule_text: One session per issue: write the spec, plan it, implement it, review it, open the PR.
not_checkable.why: Session boundaries are not in the corpus, and the phase sequence spans sessions.

not_checkable.rule_text: Before planning a feature, read `.claude/rules/<app>.md` for every app it touches.
not_checkable.why: Which apps a feature touches is not derivable before the edits exist.

not_checkable.rule_text: A bug the next feature could repeat gets a line in `.claude/review-checklist.md` in the PR that fixes it.
not_checkable.why: Deciding which fixes are repeatable bug classes is a judgement with no enumerable site.

not_checkable.rule_text: Run the security and performance review before opening a PR.
not_checkable.why: The review is prose work with no command or tool call that marks it as having happened.

not_checkable.rule_text: Skip the ADR where an existing document or ADR already dictates the choice; cite that file instead.
not_checkable.why: An exception clause to another rule; it has no independent failure signature.

not_checkable.rule_text: `docs/log.md` is append-only: `## [YYYY-MM-DD] <kind> | <what> -> <files>`.
not_checkable.why: Append-only means prior lines are unchanged, which the net diff cannot establish.
